basic_info.description: A beautifully updated home in the heart of Cayuga Terrace neighborhood. This spacious 1,990-square-foot consists of 3 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms with two master suites.  The lower level includes a family room with a kitchenette for hosting guests or relaxing with loved ones. Enjoy seamless access to the freshly manicured rear yard.  Recent updates throughout the home include recessed lighting, gleaming hardwood floors, updated bathrooms, and a freshly painted interior and exterior, ensuring a move-in ready experience.      Easy access to major freeways (280/101) for a quick commute to downtown San Francisco or the Peninsula, and proximity to local amenities such as City College of San Francisco, Stonestown Galleria and West Lake Shopping Center.
